_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "members" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), "is_sample" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_sample" IN (0, 1)), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "name_key" TEXT NULL, "role" TEXT NOT NULL, "avatar" TEXT NOT NULL, "color" TEXT NOT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "categories" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), "is_sample" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_sample" IN (0, 1)), "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "icon" TEXT NOT NULL, "color" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "accounts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), "is_sample" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_sample" IN (0, 1)), "key" TEXT NOT NULL, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "transactions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), "is_sample" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_sample" IN (0, 1)), "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL, "rate_snapshot_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "category_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "account_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "member_id" TEXT NULL, "occasion_id" TEXT NULL, "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "note_key" TEXT NULL, "recurring_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "transfers" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), "is_sample" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_sample" IN (0, 1)), "from_account_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "to_account_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_out_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "amount_in_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "rate_snapshot_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "recurring_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), "is_sample" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_sample" IN (0, 1)), "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL, "category_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "account_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "member_id" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "name_key" TEXT NULL, "frequency" TEXT NOT NULL, "next_due" TEXT NOT NULL, "day_of_month" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "budgets" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), "is_sample" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_sample" IN (0, 1)), "category_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "limit_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "rate_snapshots" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), "is_sample" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_sample" IN (0, 1)), "rates_json" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "occasions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), "is_sample" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_sample" IN (0, 1)), "key" TEXT NOT NULL, "enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("enabled" IN (0, 1)), "custom_name" TEXT NULL, "icon" TEXT NULL, "color" TEXT NULL, "custom_month_day" TEXT NULL, "days" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "occasion_dates" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), "is_sample" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_sample" IN (0, 1)), "occasion_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "year" INTEGER NOT NULL, "start_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "country" TEXT NOT NULL, "adjust_days" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("occasion_key", "year", "country"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "settings" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), "is_sample" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_sample" IN (0, 1)), "value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_outbox" ("seq" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "table_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "row_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "op" TEXT NOT NULL, "payload_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "hlc" TEXT NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_state" ("peer_device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "last_seq_seen" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "last_sync_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("peer_device_id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "devices" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "platform" TEXT NOT NULL, "last_seen_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE INDEX tx_date ON transactions (date)
CREATE INDEX tx_member_date ON transactions (member_id, date)
CREATE INDEX tx_category_date ON transactions (category_id, date)
CREATE INDEX tx_occasion ON transactions (occasion_id)
CREATE INDEX tx_account ON transactions (account_id)
CREATE INDEX transfer_date ON transfers (date)
